spot_check.method: sampled 12 mod-like posts, counted how many of their slug keywords appear anywhere in the catalog
spot_check.result: 5 of 12 look already present under a different source_url, 7 look genuinely absent
spot_check.implication: the mod-like count of 497 overstates the gap by roughly 40%, so the real number of genuinely missing mods is on the order of 290, plus an unknown share of the 782 unclear posts
spot_check.caution: keyword overlap is a weak signal in both directions -- confirm each candidate by opening the post before harvesting, and check the download still resolves
